newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV says unaffected by strike.
newsitem.headline: CANTV says unaffected by strike.

text.p: Venezuela's national telephone company CANTV said Monday a 12-hour work stoppage called by unions had been followed by very few employees and had not affected normal operations.
"Operations are completely normal," said Alexis Leoni, director of CANTV's public relations.
Leoni said just 500 of the company's 17,300 workers had joined the work stoppage which started at 0600 local/1000 GMT.
Union leaders, who called the strike Thursday after rejecting the latest pay offer, termed the stoppage a success and said they were prepared to extend industrial actions.
CANTV sent a letter to workers Friday warning them that the strike was illegal and that those who joined would be dismissed.
Union and company officials were due to meet later Monday to discuss a new pay offer. Union leaders are demanding a 125 percent salary hike.
